sentences.la: Ad silvam pergimus ut frātrēs adiuvēmus.
sentences.en: We go on to the wood to help the brothers.

sentences.la: Fēmina clāmat ut bēstiolae surgant.
sentences.en: The woman shouts so that the little creatures may get up.

sentences.la: Mulierēs ad tabernam pergunt ut mīlitem salūtent.
sentences.en: The women go on to the shop to greet the soldier.

sentences.la: Mātrōnae in vīllam intrant ut dormiant.
sentences.en: The married women enter into the country house to sleep.

sentences.la: Marītus iānitōrem arcessit quī pānem emat.
sentences.en: The husband sends for a doorkeeper to buy bread.

sentences.la: Mīlitēs tacent nē cīvis eōs prehendat.
sentences.en: The soldiers are silent so that the citizen may not seize them.

sentences.la: Vir portam claudit nē discipulus ēgrediātur.
sentences.en: The man shuts the gate so that the pupil may not go out.

sentences.la: Fīlius celeriter currit ut prīmus veniat.
sentences.en: The son runs quickly to come first.

sentences.la: Ad īnsulam proficīscimur ut magistrōs laudēmus.
sentences.en: We set out to the island to praise the teachers.

sentences.la: Albīnus exclāmat ut nymphae surgant.
sentences.en: Albinus exclaims so that the nymphs may get up.

sentences.la: Marītī ad mare accurrunt ut puellās vocent.
sentences.en: The husbands run up to the sea to call the girls.

sentences.la: Uxōrēs in cubiculum intrant ut canant.
sentences.en: The wives enter into the bedroom to sing.

sentences.la: Nūntius amīcōs vocat quī lignum ferant.
sentences.en: The messenger calls friends to carry the firewood.

sentences.la: Erī tacent nē mercātor eōs reperiat.
sentences.en: The masters are silent so that the merchant may not find them.

sentences.la: Fīlius hostibus nummōs dat ut pecūniam emant.
sentences.en: The son gives the enemies coins so that they may buy money.

sentences.la: Inimīcus statim currit ut prīmus veniat.
sentences.en: The enemy runs at once to come first.

sentences.la: Ad urbem pergimus ut mātrēs adiuvēmus.
sentences.en: We go on to the city to help the mothers.

sentences.la: Dominae clāmant ut nūntiī surgant.
sentences.en: The mistresses shout so that the messengers may get up.

sentences.la: Erus ad urbem it ut amīcōs audiat.
sentences.en: The master goes to the city to hear the friends.

sentences.la: Albīnus in ātrium it ut canat.
sentences.en: Albinus goes into the atrium to sing.

sentences.la: Aemilia ancillam vocat quae bovēs alat.
sentences.en: Aemilia calls a slave girl to feed the oxen.

sentences.la: Ursus tacet nē adulēscēns eum vocet.
sentences.en: Ursus is silent so that the young man may not call him.

sentences.la: Ōstiārius frātribus pecūniam dat ut dōna emant.
sentences.en: The porter gives the brothers money so that they may buy the gifts.

sentences.la: Dāvus statim surgit ut prīmus veniat.
sentences.en: Davus gets up at once to come first.

sentences.la: Ad lūdum currimus ut ancillās audiāmus.
sentences.en: We run to the school to hear the slave girls.
